title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Damage Protection Paid and the Protection Limit
content:
The more damage protection a Ridgeline Tool Rental renter has paid on an agreement, the higher the protection limit applied to a disputed damage repair charge on it.

> The protection paid raises the protection limit of the agreement: when the damage protection charges billed on the agreement total 150.00 dollars or more, 1000.00 dollars are added; when they total 75.00 dollars or more but less than 150.00 dollars, 500.00 dollars are added; when they total less than 75.00 dollars, nothing is added.

The total is the sum of the damage protection charge lines billed on the same agreement.

The amount is added to the protection limit of the agreement, against which the protected repair cost is measured; no amount on the way to the adjustment is rounded, the adjustment being rounded to the cent only at the end.

## Bands

| Damage protection charges billed on the agreement | Added to the protection limit |
|---|---|
| 150.00 or more | 1000.00 |
| 75.00 up to 149.99 | 500.00 |
| below 75.00 | nothing |

## Hypothetical readings

| Protection charges billed | Added |
|---|---|
| 150.00 | 1000.00 (exactly 150.00 qualifies) |
| 149.99 | 500.00 |
| 75.00 | 500.00 |
| 40.50 | nothing |
